display.title: Episode 441: The Sound of the Shofar (Rosh Chodesh Elul)
display.summary_short: Uncle Yossi welcomes Rosh Chodesh Elul with a story about a farmer boy, a bugle and a fire, showing that the shofar is an alarm that calls us to action.
display.summary_long: Broadcast on Rosh Chodesh Elul 5750. Uncle Yossi celebrates the 441st program, noting that 441 is the numerical value of emes, truth, which is found only in the Torah. After the Hakochainik march, a first-grade class from a Brooklyn girls' school recites the Shema, and everyone puts coins in the pushka. Story time prepares children for the shofar they will hear in shul the next morning. A village plagued by fires sends a farmer boy to the big city to learn what they do there. He sees the fire chief blow a bugle from a tower, buys one, and blows it at the next fire, but the houses still burn. The fire chief explains that the bugle is only an alarm to send people running for water. So too, the shofar wakes us up to act: teshuvah, tefillah and tzedakah. Uncle Yossi then teaches the Baal Shem Tov's lesson of hashgachah pratis and explains that in Elul Hashem's Thirteen Attributes of Mercy shine especially close, and that the daily shofar after davening is a call to improve in thought, speech and action. The show ends with Shabbos candle times.
display.lesson: The shofar is an alarm that calls for action: wake up and improve through teshuvah, tefillah and tzedakah.

date.note: 'Today is Rosh Chodesh Elul' and the shofar is heard 'tomorrow morning' in shul: Tuesday 30 Av 5750. Candle time 7:23 fits late August. The weekly estimate (16 Av) was two weeks early.

advisories.note: Fires burn down village homes and leave people homeless.

privacy.note: The visiting class's teacher is named on air.

sources_cited.note: 'Yom teruah yihyeh lachem': a day of sounding the shofar.
The shofar is a heavenly decree but hints at an alarm: 'wake up, sleepers'.

relations.note: The farmer boy and the bugle shofar story also aired in episode 342 (Aug 1988).
'Tekias Shofar 342' has the same shofar introduction and lesson.

quality.notes: Master catalog lists 'The sly fox and the cheese' for 441, but the story is the farmer boy and the bugle. The opening of the Elul talk (Baal Shem Tov's birthday) is missing from the ASR around 22:40-23:27 but present in the clip.
